title: lobster-data analysis output
description: Output contract for lobster-data role. Validated by GM at handoff. Uses schema_version + prompt_version for traceability.

schema_version.description: Version of this output schema (semver). Bump on breaking changes.

prompt_version.description: Version of the prompt that produced this output (semver).

results.description: Task-specific results. Fields vary by task_type.

artifacts.description: Paths to all output files (analysis.md, query.sql, plot.png, etc.)

data_caveats.description: Honest list of data limitations, missing values, distribution shifts, sample size issues

human_approval_needed.description: Set to true if this output requires human approval before any downstream action

human_approval_reason.description: If human_approval_needed, explain what needs approval

cost_estimate.description: Optional: estimated cost of running this in production
